description:
Manually enter an attendance record in AttendHRM for employee 'Robert Johnson' (Employee ID: EMP003). The biometric system failed on January 15, 2025. You must record that he worked from 09:00 to 18:00 on that date.

Steps:
1. Navigate to the Attendance module.
2. Locate the manual attendance entry screen.
3. Select employee 'Robert Johnson' (EMP003).
4. Set the date to 15/01/2025.
5. Enter In-Time as 09:00 and Out-Time as 18:00.
6. Save the record.
